description.zh: 基于 Operit 原生记忆库的角色隔离记忆层，支持状态标记、自动召回、概率衰减、观察期、修订和可审计遗忘。
description.en: A role-scoped memory layer built on Operit's native memory library with recall, decay, quarantine, revision, and auditable forgetting.

description.zh: 创建、召回、标记、修订、遗忘、恢复和解释记忆。
description.en: Create, recall, mark, revise, forget, restore, and explain memories.
